form_inputs.box_type: Prompt Routing / Output-Time Compliance / Artifact Contract Gate
form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Before emitting terminal code, patch delivery instructions, validation commands, freeze-form JSON, validation evidence, KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json, or multi-project freeze paths, request or apply pre_output_contract_gates.
Install success terminal blocks must use the 5-second Clear-Host footer with no Enter prompts.
Validation, diagnostic, install-error, validation-error, and other terminal blocks must use Enter, Clear-Host, Enter, Clear-Host.
Never mix terminal cleanup patterns.
Patch delivery must move the ZIP from the drive root into <project>_delete_after_daily_work before extraction and must freshly extract.
Freeze-form JSON must be exact marker-wrapped valid JSON without markdown, comments, trailing commas, or prose inside markers.
Freeze-ready validation evidence must include VALIDATION OK: <feature_id> after local validation passes.
Startup sync evidence must use STATUS: IN_SYNC.
Freeze-ready patch ZIPs must include root-level KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json unless intentionally non-freezeable and explained.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must describe the current feature and remain delivery metadata unless a governed app contract says otherwise.
Sidecar identity beats stale chat memory.
Same-feature or same-source rescans must not downgrade recognizer-friendly validation evidence.
Freeze-intake and frozen-memory paths must use the selected active project root.
Do not store active project freeze-intake state or frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Do not load all prompts daily just to enforce output-time contracts.
Fast Path explanation-only tasks must not over-route.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.known_warnings: This patch adds prompt-level output-time contract gates and startup routing hooks. It does not change app-side freeze writer code. App-side freeze hint intake and monotonic validation preservation are protected by earlier freeze-hint features.
form_inputs.notes: This feature targets the failure mode where the AI routes correctly but later violates KANDA canon while emitting terminal code, patch delivery instructions, freeze-form JSON, validation evidence, sidecar metadata, or multi-project freeze paths. Source patch ZIP: pre_output_contract_gates_v1_patch.zip.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Install and validate this patch locally, merge recognizer-friendly validation evidence into the saved freeze hint, then freeze Pre-Output Contract Gates v1.
form_inputs.validation_evidence_summary:
VALIDATION OK: pre_output_contract_gates_v1
CONTRACT_TEST_OK: pre-output contract prompt, routing hook, startup sync, and artifact gate rules validated
SANDBOX_PRE_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_GATES_VALIDATION_OK
STATUS: IN_SYNC
pre_output_contract_gates_v1 is installed and startup delivery is in sync.
